items.title: 66086_Zilner T. Randolph oral history interview
items.q: I don't know whether you know this young man or not, he's a very good arranger. His name is Kenneth Anderson.

ctx.x: I don't know whether you know this young man or not, he's a very good arranger. His name is Kenneth Anderson. Kenneth said, -- he was down to one of the publishers downtown, and said to the fellow, picks up the arrangement, 'Old Man Mose, piano copy, say, Ken, here's a lousy tune. Ken say, you mean that score is a lousy score. Say, I
know the man that wrote the tune. Said, the tune itself is a very nice tune. But that score isn't the tune.
